summary: Sound bounded classical mathematical scope; revise the incomplete graph prerequisite and pin regression acceptance before production.

intent.reason: MATH-52 defines one classical finite convex support card and fixed-output mapping; no model/GPU/token/end-to-end or Engine/tmux benefit claims.

guide.reason: GUIDE.md is actually empty; guide README only defines governance. Human-only guide and concurrent normal-mixture incomplete-CI state are preserved; no advice is adopted.

assumptions.reason: Nonempty finite vectors, nonnegative unit-mass weights, affine rank and fixed W are explicit. Nullspace elimination is valid on positive support. Single-query existence, original-weight renormalization and projected-output limits are distinguished; public exact fixtures do not prove the general theorem.

prior_results.reason: Actual prior search is preserved with partial coverage and missing-record errors. No measured old results are consumed; knowledge hits are only premise-audited references.

acceptance.reason: Identical frozen six-domain result contracts precede publication, but the actual DAG references an absent prerequisite node and the scoped five-module regression acceptance is not identified by executable module/command names.

risk.reason: Public finite CPU fixtures, confined single-writer paths and independent result review limit risk; failures remain preserved and unrelated work/SGLang/human guide excluded.

resources.reason: 1200 seconds, two plan cycles, two production attempts and CPU 90-second subprocess bounds fit this small exact task. Python/local reads are available; no GPU, model or remote backend is needed for claimed scope.

findings.feedback: produce depends on independent-plan, but independent-plan is not a node in the actual DAG. The bound stable Plan describes more stages than the three-node JSON. A manual execution disclaimer does not make a dangling dependency a complete frozen graph.
findings.requested_change: Add an explicit independent-plan gate node with its receipt/hash acceptance and no producer dispatch until approved. Represent startup/search and publication/sync stages as explicit nodes or clearly declared already-completed prerequisites and ordered substeps, retaining the distinct result gate.
findings.acceptance_check: Every depends_on resolves to a node or explicit completed prerequisite; graph is acyclic; produce is blocked on this exact approved plan and publish is blocked on usable-with-scope independent result validation.

findings.feedback: Five-module targeted regressions are promised without naming the modules or executable commands. Therefore a producer could select a materially different suite and still claim the promised gate. Exact test count may vary; a count alone is not required.
findings.requested_change: Pin the five regression module names/commands, plugin snapshot synchronization check and acceptance condition in bound stable plan/protocol. Keep expected count diagnostic and preserve errors/skips rather than treating 53ish as a hard oracle.
findings.acceptance_check: Independent verifier can run the frozen commands, bind their raw stdout/stderr and evaluate complete passing acceptance for the intended suite and mirror check.

findings.feedback: All eleven supplied bindings match actual bytes, including the task detail currently bound as whole-file bytes. Guide directory also contains README.md, which was read but is absent from bindings.
findings.requested_change: In revision include a guide inventory and README digest, and document that ordinary Progress appends retain original frozen detail snapshot/stable Plan identity.
findings.acceptance_check: All guide paths are accounted for without editing any guide file; later progress appends do not silently replace the reviewed stable plan.

execution_boundary: Actual separate review context only; this file does not authenticate Engine/ReviewSession or grant user/host authorization. It does not validate produced results.
